entities.summary: Thanh Lam (b. 1969-06-19, Hanoi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hanoi and Vietnam. Known in the fields of vietnam, composers & musicians, asia.
